name: Deer Creek Village RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.8667,-105.8648: rows of RV pads on open grass; the north end of the park opens onto a sandy, lightly treed flat ~35-60 m from the North Platte, Deer Creek is behind a tree band to the west; the river is visible from the north rows but sites are not on the bank; riverview

name: Chuck Wagon RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.2133,-104.5217: small RV park between the railroad and US-26 in Fort Laramie; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: Lakeview Haven RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.5085,-105.0229: RV rows in a gravel lot in the town of Glendo beside the railroad; Glendo Reservoir is several km away and not in frame; not waterfront

name: JMA Campground (Jim Moss Arena)
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 43.1581,-108.5096: arena, buildings and scattered RV pads on open sagebrush flats west of Riverton; an irrigation ditch runs ~150 m west; not waterfront
